items.title: Item 1
items.text: WDAY Jumps Over 10% on World Model Success ********************************************** Workday (NASDAQ:WDAY ) rocketed 11% higher ahead of the opening bell after quarterly results beat expectations , with AI demand surging thanks to its proprietary database engine, with annualized revenue from AI solutions approaching $500 million. * “For AI, the world model is like the holy grail”: Gerrit Kazmaier, the president for product and tech, detailed how the engine – known as the world model – builds off the 80 million users under contract and approximately 1.4 trillion transactions annually to give Workday “a set of data and context that no other competitor can replicate.” * “Our core business is strong, our AI strategy is working, and we’re moving with the speed…to lead”: CEO Aneel Bhusri also noted core operations are performing well, with subscription revenue up 14.3% year over year (YoY). The stock is recommended by Team Rule Breakers and Team Hidden Gems. Pore over the earnings call transcript ---------------------------------------------------

items.title: Item 2
items.text: Thursday’s Earnings From Team Rule Breakers Recs --------------------------------------------------- * Take-Two Interactive (NASDAQ:TTWO ) popped over 6% before the market opened due to the quarterly loss narrowing significantly , with solid mobile and sports gaming performances. The highly anticipated Grand Theft Auto VI is still slated for release in November. * Copart (NASDAQ:CPRT ) was little changed in pre-market trading due to a mixed bag of results . Earnings beat expectations thanks to areas such as the UK and Brazil, but concerns around a slowing overall growth trajectory weighed on the stock. * Zoom (NASDAQ:ZM ) rose 8% before the opening bell as earnings beat forecasts and full-year guidance was hiked, based on strong enterprise growth and rapid customer adoption of new AI tools. The stock is also recommended by Team Hidden Gems. Read Yasser El-Shimy’s hot take on ZM -------------------------------------------

items.title: Item 3
items.text:
Quantum Stocks Soar on Government Grants ------------------------------------------- IBM (NYSE:IBM ) closed 12% higher yesterday, the largest single-day gain in over a year, alongside a 15% jump in GlobalFoundries (NASDAQ:GFS ), as the U.S. government announced new grants for selected companies in exchange for equity stakes. * Nine companies related to quantum computing selected: The move shows the growing interest in quantum computing with regards to national security, with a spread of companies receiving between $38 million and $1 billion in funding. * IBM awarded $1 billion to go towards building a chip foundry: The largest beneficiary is IBM, which will be adding $1 billion of its own cash into the new project, based out of a semiconductor research center in New York. Review why AI competition could hurt IBM A message from The Motley Fool

items.title: Item 4
items.text: Anthropic Eyes Microsoft Maia AI Chips ****************************************** CNBC reports Microsoft (NASDAQ:MSFT ) is in talks with Anthropic to supply custom AI chips, as Anthropic continues to diversify away from its heavy historical leaning on Nvidia (NASDAQ:NVDA ) hardware. * Custom chips likely to be based on the 2nd-gen Maia product: Microsoft announced the latest Maia 200 processor back in January, offering a 30% improvement in the tokens per dollar cost, and which will be used to run OpenAI’s GPT 5.2 model. * Anthropic widens provider base to expand compute potential: Earlier in May, CEO Dario Amodei said the business has had some difficulties with compute, with any potential Microsoft deal building on the Amazon (NASDAQ:AMZN ) chip deal agreed last month. See how much MAG 7 exposure makes sense ***********************************************

items.title: Item 6
items.text: Your Take ************** YESTERDAY'S TOP RESPONSE We asked: How do you balance conviction in the business against the fear of buying at the top? R Member rgomove said “What influences my buying decision at a perceived "top" is the growth path and future expanded opportunities. Examples include [Eli Lilly (NYSE:LLY )] with growing stable of drugs such as GLPs and expanded indications.” See more great answers from our Foolish community TODAY’S QUESTION Yesterday saw the latest Stock Advisor recommendation , Corning (NYSE:GLW ), released! When a dividend yield shrinks because the stock has run so hard – Corning’s fell from 4.4% at its low in the fall of 2023 to 0.6% today – how does that change your view? Does the capital appreciation make up for the lost income potential? Share with us in the comments on today’s article! Have a question you’d love to hear your fellow members weigh in on? Send it to breakfastnews@fool.com ( breakfastnews@fool.com?subject=Your%20Take ) and it could feature in a future edition.
